name: Religion
notes: Five courses: a scripture course, a religious-history course, and three further religion courses chosen with your departmental advisor.
RELC 293 (Theories of Religion) is named on the page but is absent from the 2025-26 catalog.

requirementGroups.label: Hebrew Bible or New Testament
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Minor in Religion: RELC 101: Introduction to the Hebrew Bible or RELC 102: Introduction to the New Testament

requirementGroups.label: One course in the history of a religious tradition
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One course in the history of a religious tradition: RELC 103: History of Judaism; RELC 104: History of Christianity; RELC 105: Asian Search for Self; RELC 106: From Confucius to Zen; RELC 107: History of Islam; RELC 293: Theories of Religion

requirementGroups.label: Three further religion courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Three other courses in religion, selected in consultation with the student's advisor in the department
